subject: math
cluster: Understand congruence in terms of rigid motions

items.prompt:
In $\triangle ABC\cong\triangle DEF$, side $\overline{AB}$ corresponds to:
A) $\overline{DF}$
B) $\overline{DE}$
C) $\overline{EF}$
D) $\overline{AC}$

CPCTC is used:
A) Before proving congruence
B) After proving two triangles congruent
C) Only for circles
D) Never
items.answer: B) After proving two triangles congruent

steps: Once congruent, corresponding parts are equal by CPCTC.
